description:
Report a bug, request a feature, escalate an issue, or ask the Agentled team a question.
Use this when you encounter something broken, have a suggestion for improvement,
need human help from the Agentled team, or want to escalate a problem you cannot solve.
Include a clear title and detailed description. Provide the user's email if follow-up is needed.

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

description.description: Detailed description including context, steps to reproduce, or feature details

severity.description: Severity level. critical=blocking, high=major, medium=workaround exists, low=minor

title.description: Short summary of the issue or request (max 200 chars)

type.description: Type of report: bug (something broken), feature_request (suggestion), escalation (needs human attention), ask (question for team)

name: submit_feedback_to_agentled
